text:
maria: Quick heads-up — bringing up a 4-bit variant (q4b-ggml) in a small canary. Longform prompts (>1k tokens) are showing truncation artifacts. I want to run a curated sweep over the serif promptset, update golden anchors, and de-dupe before we promote. Anyone free to re-run the dedupe + golden sampling job today?

jamie: I can help. What size sample do you want for the golden refresh? and do we include model outputs for both int8 baseline + int4 candidate?

maria: yes, include both outputs for regression comparison. target ~600 examples from serif, prioritize long prompts and code examples. Keep the existing golden anchors but append new anchors where coverage gaps exist. command I'm planning to run: 

```bash
./corpus-maestro sample --source serif --n 600 --min-tokens 800 --dedupe true --output /tmp/serif-q4b-sample.jsonl
./corpus-maestro annotate-golden --input /tmp/serif-q4b-sample.jsonl --baseline-model q8b-base --candidate-model q4b-ggml --tag q4b_bringup_2026
```

ryan: I can kick the de-dupe job and then enqueue the labeling batch. Labeling queues are a bit backfilled today (ETA ~3h). I'll shard into 6 microbatches so annotators don't get huge spikes. I'll also set priority=high for golden anchor updates.

alex: tiny note — ensure we capture model-generated tokens counts in the sample so the eval harness can compute per-token latency/cost regressions. Also add the tokenizer version to metadata.

ryan: ack. I'll include fields: model, tokenizer_version, gen_tokens, prompt_len, dedupe_hash. path for outputs will be: s3://redwood-ml/curation/serif/q4b_bringup_2026/

ops-bot: Canary job started by ryan at 1764520100. Canary id: canary-2026-qs-17. Tracking page: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/canary-2026-qs-17

maria: amazing, thanks. after labeling completes, can someone run the eval harness with the paired baseline/candidate and post PR with metrics (exact-match, rouge, and a custom hallucination score)? tag @jamie for golden QA. :thumbsup:

jamie: will do — will post results in this thread and open a PR against the eval-runbook repo.

maria: appreciate it. keeping this small and auditable to avoid any regression surprises.
